title: Agent + Client SMS CDR / Detail reports: newest OTP appears at the top automatically

problem.reported: A newly received OTP/SMS is not reliably shown at the top of the Agent and Client SMS CDR / Detail reports; older records stay above it and it only becomes visible after searching/filtering by a Range or another filter action.
problem.root_cause: Frontend staleness. The CDR/Detail views were loaded once (page open / navigation) and never re-fetched: no polling of any kind existed on these pages, and the shared client-side GET cache (api.js: /sms 5 s, /sms/paged 2.5 s, key = full URL incl. query) kept every repeat request on the same URL stale. Changing a filter changed the URL, so it missed the cache and pulled fresh data - exactly the 'it appears after searching a Range' symptom.
backend_verified_correct: GET /api/sms            -> ORDER BY s.received_at DESC LIMIT <role cap> (smsRowsForScope)
GET /api/sms/paged      -> ORDER BY s.received_at DESC, s.id DESC (smsPagedOrderSql, sort=date&dir=desc)
received_at is written by every ingest path as UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (datetime('now') default; carrier api_dt normalised by parseIncomingDate) -> string ordering == chronological ordering
page-1 / page-2 windows are disjoint and strictly descending (asserted in the harness, A5-A8)

fix.scope: frontend only (agent.html, client.html). No backend, no SQL, no schema, no permission change.
fix.mechanism: P20 latest-first auto refresh: every GX_SMS_REFRESH_MS (8000 ms, only when the browser tab is visible AND one of the affected report pages is the active page) the panel asks for two cheap facts - the newest row of its own role scope (limit 1) and the scoped total - via GET /api/sms/paged?page=1&limit=1&sort=date&dir=desc. When either fact changes (new top record, or a new row whose carrier timestamp is older) the visible page is re-loaded through ITS OWN existing loader with a cache-bypassing GET. On tab focus (visibilitychange) the check runs immediately. No rows are ever loaded into the browser just to detect changes.
fix.cache_bypass: the refresh GETs append an unknown _gxr=<ms> query key: the endpoints ignore it, and it changes both the browser cache key (api.js cachedGet) and the server read-cache key, so the just-received record is really fetched.

loaders_used.agent smsReport: renderSmsReport(true) - the page's existing server-paged renderer (page/limit/search/from/to/tfrom/tto/range/number/sort untouched)
loaders_used.agent smsDetail: renderSmsDetail(true) - existing server-paged renderer; current page + filters kept
loaders_used.client stats (SMS Detailed Report): renderStats(true) - existing server-paged renderer; current page + filters kept
loaders_used.client dashboard Recent Activity: gxRenderClientRecent(d.recent) from a fresh GET /dashboard - only that card's newest-SMS list is re-rendered; KPI cards, charts and map are untouched

fix.page_open_fresh: opening the two agent report pages now loads with fresh=1 (loadSms(true) / renderStats(true)) so the newest record is there on first paint as well.
fix.pagination_behaviour: the loaders re-run with the current pager state; the signature only resets the page when filters/page-size change, so a refresh never jumps the user back to page 1 and never duplicates rows (the table is re-rendered from the response, never appended).

not_changed: backend/server.js and every other backend file (byte-identical to v6)
manager.html, admin.html, management.html, test.html, assets/*, api.js (byte-identical to v6)
report columns, filters, sorting, grouping, pagination, CSV/export, permissions and role scoping
rates, payout calculations, provider rate, allocation/ownership, CDR/SMS storage, authentication

tests.run: cd galaxy-ui-work && bash reseed-fixture.sh && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pwlibs/root/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/tmp/pwlibs/root/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu node test-latest-otp.cjs
tests.result: 55 PASS / 0 FAIL on a freshly re-seeded fixture; the harness deletes the SMS rows it injects
covered: A: backend ordering = newest first, stored received_at used as-is, page 1/2 disjoint + descending, client scope respected

S1 agent SMS Report: new SMS at top automatically (measured ~6 s) without any filter action; 2nd SMS becomes the new top; ordering kept; no duplicate copy; multi-page pagination via the pager; back to page 1; range filter; search filter; 0 JS errors
S2 agent Detail Report: same set + number filter
S3 client Detailed Report: same set + number filter
S4 client dashboard Recent Activity: newest SMS at top automatically; 0 JS errors

regressions_green_on_final_code.smoke-all-panels.cjs: 51 pages / 0 JS errors / 0 write API calls

notes: The client panel has no page literally titled 'SMS CDR Report'; its newest-OTP surfaces are the SMS Detailed Report page and the dashboard Recent Activity list - both are covered (the dashboard fix touches only that card's list).

The isolated fixture stores synthetic SMS rows at a fixed 10:00:00 per day (some of them in the future relative to the sandbox clock), so the harness injects the new arrivals with a carrier timestamp just after the current maximum - the same field a real carrier callback fills (api_dt).
Polling is skipped while the tab is hidden and while none of the affected pages is active, so background load is one limit-1 request every 8 s per open report page.
apply: copy agent.html and client.html over the current install and hard-refresh the panels. No backend restart needed, no DB migration, no config change.
